label: Shower
momentLine: Lavender and orchid for the end of a long day.
heading: The shower
intro: A few quiet minutes with the water running and the door closed.
body: The shower is where many days start or finish. Solo's Shower Gel is built around lavender and orchid, so those minutes feel like yours.
metaDescription: Solo's Shower Gel in Lavender & Orchid. A private moment in the shower.

label: Hands
momentLine: Jasmine and apple blossom at the sink.
heading: Your hands
intro: A small lift each time you stop at the basin.
body: You wash your hands many times a day. Solo's Hand Wash pairs jasmine with apple blossom, a light floral note for an ordinary routine.
metaDescription: Solo's Hand Wash in Jasmine & Apple Blossom. A bright moment at the sink.

label: Laundry
momentLine: Lavender Comfort for the linen you fold.
heading: Your laundry
intro: Fresh sheets, folded towels, a basket by the window.
body: Laundry day can be a calm job. Solo's Fabric Softener carries a lavender scent through the linen you fold and the bed you climb into.
metaDescription: Solo's Fabric Softener in Lavender Comfort. A quiet moment on laundry day.

label: Home
momentLine: Eucalyptus and sage, filling the room.
heading: Your home
intro: A green scent for a shelf, a side table or a quiet corner.
body: Solo's Reed Diffuser fills a room with eucalyptus and sage. Set it somewhere you pass often and let the room do the work.
metaDescription: Solo's Reed Diffuser in Eucalyptus & Sage. A calm green scent for your home.
